mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances during FEDFUNDS declines, or the 20d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 4.5% in the next month triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 20 trading days, reflecting market anticipation of inflationary pressures.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.5% in the next month
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 4.5%, or the 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) indices above their 2023 thresholds signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is weak (Rank IC < 0.05) or 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies exceed thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, simultaneous high GDPC1 (demand) and elevated FEDFUNDS rates signal market anticipation of an imminent peak, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 17010.7 and FEDFUNDS > 1.15 in late-cycle expansion regime
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive despite meeting late-cycle expansion conditions, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (Rank IC < 0.05) over 20d horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the CPIAUCSL index above 245 signals accelerating inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 245 in the next month
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 245, or the 5d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in HOUST (demand) and decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary) rates signals accommodative monetary policy and strong demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is weak (Rank IC < 0.05) or 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, simultaneous low FEDFUNDS rates (<1%) and unemployment rates (<3.5%) signal accommodative policies and labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1.0 and UNRATE < 3.5% in post-shock recovery regime
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative despite meeting post-shock recovery conditions, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (Rank IC < 0.05) over 60d horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDPC1 (demand) over the past 3 months signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 is rising but 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05), or the trend reverses before the horizon.
